messages.content: Artificial DEMO model-spec trace for Storybook. It mirrors the compiler-owned decision surfaces without claiming a completed fit.
Specify the validated daily model with 7 constructs and 10 retained indicators.

Materialized one likelihood per indicator (gamma=2, gaussian=1, negative_binomial=1, ordered_logistic=6) and 48 compiler-shaped prior surfaces. The model uses stationary initialization, free eligible observation intercepts, and no equilibrium forcing. Sparse safety and event channels remain visible as warnings rather than being silently removed.
